title: Canonical proper/open restriction adjunct and finite evaluation coordinates
statement: Use constant-$B$ strict-tower operations and exact open extension [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], for a commutative ring $B$ in universe $u+1$ and schemes in universe $u$. For a commutative proper/open square $Q$ with quasi-compact open horizontal maps, use its canonical clopen lift, cartesian open comparison, open-to-direct-image map, and direct-image compositors [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define the open restriction map $(J_kR_p)G_i\to R_s$ as the cartesian inverse/direct-image mate, followed by the restricted-extension identification across the clopen lift, its open-to-direct-image map, and direct-image composition. For an isomorphism $\lambda:(J_kR_p)G_i\cong R_s$, define its open adjunct to be the $J_i\dashv G_i$ adjunct of $\lambda^{-1}$. For a supplied finite scalar etale origin $w$ of the nth evaluation of a strict tower $N$ [def-cbc-finite-constant-coefficient-transport], define finite-source and finite-target identifications by the actual evaluation/direct-image and evaluation/open mates followed by the same origin isomorphism. Define the finite proper/open comparison to be the normalized etale isomorphism of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] at $w$'s retained bounded etale antecedent. These are the canonical maps used in the finite-evaluation equation; no invertibility of the restriction map and no equality with the tower gamma is asserted by this definition.
